name: Capital Kids Summer Day Camp
operator_name: Montpelier Recreation (City of Montpelier Community Services Department)
description_short: City-run licensed day camp for grades 1-6 at the Montpelier Recreation Area, running eight one-week themed sessions with arts and crafts, games and sports, STEAM projects and daily pool trips. Thursdays have a field trip or a specialty workshop.
refund_policy_summary: You must submit the Cancellation Form to the Rec Center before June 12 to get a refund, minus a $50 administrative fee. Cancellations after June 12 get a 50% refund. If you book more than two weeks, you pay two weeks up front, half the balance by April 17 and the rest by June 12. Campers whose balance isn't paid by June 12 are taken off the roster.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily trips to the Montpelier city pool are included in the registration fee.

Session prices are the full-day resident rate for the first camper ($175). Non-residents pay $225. Half-day options (B mornings, C afternoons) are $110 resident / $145 non-resident. Second-camper discounts apply.
